jobDescription:
Location Noida Lucknow Chandigarh Hyderabad Experience 1-3 Years 3-6 Years 6-10 Years Trending Opportunities We promise you an inclusive work environment where you will fall in love with challenging as well as getting challenged. Showing 10 positions AL/ML Engineer Noida AL/ML Engineer Noida Apply Now About the role The role of a Machine Learning (ML) Engineer is centered around the application of machine learning algorithms and statistical models to solve real-world problems. ML engineers build and deploy models that allow systems to improve automatically through experience and data, often contributing to the development of AI (Artificial Intelligence) products. What you’ll do Design, Build, and Optimize Machine Learning Models. Develop predictive or classification models. Optimize models for scalability and performance. Deploy models into production. Collaborate with the sales team to understand client needs. Present technical solutions,demonstrate how they meet client objectives. Participate in client meetings and contribute to proposal development. Work with various departments, including Engineering and sales. Communicate complex concepts to technical stakeholders. Monitor and maintain live models. Stay current with industry trends, tools, and technologies. Participate in professional development opportunities. What you’ll need Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Machine Learning, or a related field. 3-4 years of hands-on experience in machine learning, NLP, OCR, and production environments. Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks like Tensor Flow, Py Torch, or Keras. Strong experience in API development (Fast API, Flask, or Django) Knowledge of queuing systems like Rabbit MQ, Redis, or Celery for handling a synchronous tasks. Expertise in NLP techniques and OCR tools (Tesseract, Open CV). Experience with NLP libraries (Spa Cy, NLTK) and OCR frameworks. Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud) and MLOps practices for streamlined model deployment. Location : Noida Experience : 4-6 Years Apply Now Tech Lead Node.js Noida Tech Lead Node.js Noida Apply Now Job description Expert in advanced Java Script, strong coding proficiency with Node.js and its frameworks. Knowledge on Node.js, REST architecture, Microservices. Understanding of the nature of asynchronous programming and its quirks and workarounds. Knowledge in Docker containers. Working knowledge of Promises, call back hell and ways to avoid it. Familiarity with database technologies such as Mongo DB, My SQL, Postgre SQL etc. Restful web services, service-oriented architectures. Familiarity with cloud message APIs and push notifications. Understanding fundamental design principles behind a scalable application. Good analytical and problem solving skills. Ability to translate business requirements into technical requirements. Couchbase experience, or extensive familiarity with SQL or other No SQL (experience with Redis is a plus) An Agile mindset with experience working in Agile environment. A spirit of collaboration and transparent communication. Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to interact professionally with a diverse group of people. Good interaction with other development teams, Dev Ops teams, managers, and team members to coordinate job tasks and strong commitment to work. Good Knowledge of Version Control is must. Basic knowledge of CI, CD, Dev Ops (Jenkins) Intermediate knowledge in any cloud services (AWS, Azure) User authentication and authorization between multiple systems, servers, and environments Integration of multiple data sources and databases into one system

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Coordinate tasks among team members, providing support and guidance as needed for ontime sprint delivery. Assess and communicate blockers and risks from all team members to managers for effective resolution. Produce minimal and clean code with more reusability and review/fix code by other developers in the team. Collaborate with team members to contribute to improvements in process and infrastructure. Following and implementing the latest coding trends, tricks/hacks and best practices along with conveying the message to the other team members. Develop and implement low-latency, highly performant server-side components by writing efficient, reusable, and maintainable code. Leverage available tools/systems to proactively identify and resolve defects. Implement effective security protocols and data protection measures. Location : Noida Experience : 10+ years Apply Now Social Media Executive Noida Social Media Executive Noida Apply Now About the Role We are looking for a creative and results-driven Social Media Executive to join our dynamic marketing team. You will be responsible for managing and executing our social media strategy to enhance brand awareness, engage our audience, and support marketing goals. What you’ll do Develop, implement, and manage social media strategies across platforms like Linked In, Instagram, Twitter, Facebook, and You Tube. Create engaging and visually appealing content (text, image, video, reels, etc.) aligned with brand identity. Monitor and analyze performance metrics to track effectiveness and optimize content. Stay updated with the latest social media trends, tools, and best practices. Collaborate with content, design, and marketing teams for campaign planning and execution. Manage and grow online communities by engaging with followers, responding to queries, and encouraging meaningful interactions. Coordinate with internal stakeholders for promotions, events, and announcements. What you’ll need Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field. 1–3 years of proven experience in managing corporate social media accounts. Strong understanding of social media platforms, tools (like Buffer, Hootsuite, or Sprout Social), and analytics. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. A creative mindset with a passion for storytelling and content creation. Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. Location : Noida Experience : 1-3 Years Apply Now On-Site Project / Product Manager US On-Site Project / Product Manager US Apply Now Position Overview We are seeking a disciplined and results-driven On-Site Project / Product Manager with strong execution capabilities, executive-level communication skills, and a proven track record of managing high-visibility, compliance-driven initiatives. This role is responsible for leading cross-functional teams, ensuring governance and risk controls, and delivering projects that align with strategic business objectives and drive measurable growth. Key Responsibilities
1. Onsite Project & Product Leadership Lead on-site execution of mobile and web application projects across the full SDLC (planning, design, development, testing, deployment). Lead end-to-end project and/or product lifecycle from initiation through delivery and closure. Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget Translate business objectives into actionable project plans, product roadmaps, and deliverables. Drive execution discipline, accountability, and continuous improvement across teams.
2. Stakeholder Management Build and maintain strong relationships with executive leadership, clients, and cross-functional teams Act as the primary on-site point of contact between business, technology, and operational stakeholders Manage stakeholder expectations through proactive communication and transparency Facilitate executive briefings, status reports, and decision-making discussions Resolve conflicts and align priorities across diverse stakeholder groups
3. Governance & Compliance Establish and enforce project governance frameworks, standards, and best practices Define roles, responsibilities, and accountability structures for project teams. Conduct governance reviews, audits, and checkpoints to ensure quality and compliance.
4. Risk Management & Mitigation Identify, assess, and manage risks, issues, and dependencies across projects Develop and implement mitigation strategies, contingency plans, and escalation paths Monitor project health through KPIs, dashboards, and performance metrics Proactively address potential roadblocks to ensure successful delivery Lead structured problem-solving and issue resolution efforts
5. Business Growth & Strategic Impact Align project and product outcomes with broader organizational goals and growth strategies. Drive initiatives that enhance operational efficiency, customer experience, and scalability. Identify opportunities for innovation, process improvement, and value creation Support business development efforts, including proposals, solution design, and client presentations. Utilize data-driven insights to inform decision-making and improve outcomes.
6. Core Project Management Functions Develop and execute communication plans for all stakeholders Ensure adherence to project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid) Manage budgets, forecasts, and financial tracking with accuracy. Track progress, report status, and ensure alignment with organizational priorities. Collaborate with senior leaders on portfolio-level tracking. Qualifications & Experience Master’s degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, or related field. 5+ years of experience in project management, product management, business sales, or related roles. Proven experience managing complex, cross-functional, and compliance-driven initiatives. Strong understanding of project management frameworks (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall). Experience with governance, risk management, and stakeholder engagement. Demonstrated ability to drive business outcomes and strategic initiatives. Key Skills & Competencies Strong leadership, organizational, and execution skills. Excellent verbal and written communication, including executive-level presentations. Strategic thinking with a focus on business value and growth. Problem-solving and analytical capabilities. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Proficiency in project management tools and reporting systems. Success Metrics On-time and within-budget delivery of projects. Stakeholder satisfaction and engagement levels. Effective risk mitigation and issue resolution. Compliance with governance and regulatory standards. Contribution to product growth, user adoption, and business outcomes. - Government Sales Noida Business Manager
- Government Sales Noida Apply Now About the Role We are seeking an experienced Business Development Manager (BDM) – Government Sales who will be responsible for driving business growth through government sector engagements, tenders, empanelments, and long-term partnerships. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of government procurement processes, GEM portal, e-tendering, and should be able to establish and nurture strong relationships with key stakeholders in ministries, PSUs, and government departments. What you’ll do Identify and pursue new business opportunities in Central & State Government, PSUs, and allied agencies. Manage the entire tendering process – from bid preparation, documentation, submission, to post-bid follow-ups. Build and maintain strong relationships with decision-makers in government bodies. Drive registration, empanelment, and vendor onboarding with relevant govt. agencies. Monitor government procurement portals (GEM, CPP, e-procurement portals) for relevant opportunities. Collaborate with internal teams (technical, finance, legal) to prepare winning proposals and RFP responses. Achieve sales targets and revenue growth by closing large government deals. Track competitor activities and market trends in government sales. Ensure compliance with all statutory, legal, and organizational requirements while executing contracts. What you’ll need Proven track record in government / PSU business development & sales. Strong understanding of GEM, CPP, e-Tendering platforms. Excellent knowledge of government procurement policies, procedures, and vendor management. Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Ability to manage complex sales cycles and long-term relationships. Strong network within government departments is highly desirable. Self-motivated, result-oriented, and able to work independently. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in visual design, creating presentation, know how government sector works, and content creation for digital and offline marketing campaigns. You will be responsible for creating engaging graphics, and branding assets that align with our marketing and business objectives. What you'll do Design creative visuals for social media, websites, digital campaigns, and marketing materials. Develop graphics for brochures, banners, standees, hoardings, presentations, and other branding collaterals. Collaborate with the marketing and content teams to conceptualize and execute creative campaigns. Ensure brand consistency across all visual and video assets. Stay updated with industry trends, design techniques, and video editing best practices. Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines. What you'll need 1-3 years of experience in Graphic Design Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects). Strong understanding of typography, color theory, layout design, and visual storytelling. Experience creating social media creatives, motion graphics, and short-form video content. Knowledge of video shooting, basic animation, and motion graphics is a plus. Strong creativity, attention to detail, and communication skills. Location : Noida Experience : 2-4 years Apply Now Recruitment Associate (Government Vertical) Noida Recruitment Associate (Government Vertical) Noida Apply Now Job description We are looking for a proactive, well-networked, and result-driven Recruitment Associate (Government Vertical) to independently manage end-to-end hiring for our specialized mandates across government consulting, public sector undertakings (PSUs), political campaigns, and public policy ecosystems. With 2 to 4 years of solid sourcing experience, the ideal candidate must be a versatile hybrid recruiter capable of seamlessly switching between IT and Non-IT hiring. What you'll do Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle for both IT and Non-IT roles across government relations, public affairs, and political consulting mandates Source specialized technical talent (e.g., Java Full Stack, .NET Developers) and creative/content professionals (e.g., SEO Specialists, Content Writers, Graphic Designers). Leverage job boards (Naukri), Linked In Recruiter, social media, and portfolio platforms to identify active and passive talent. Collaborate closely with hiring managers to understand evolving client/project mandates and translate them into effective talent attraction strategies. Conduct detailed preliminary interviews to assess candidates on functional skills, technical/creative portfolios, and cultural fit. Build and nurture an active, readily deployable pipeline of talent familiar with working on fast-paced, high-stakes government timelines. Manage interview scheduling, coordinate technical or creative assessments, maintain data hygiene on trackers, and report hiring metrics regularly Act as the primary brand ambassador, ensuring a respectful, transparent, and seamless experience for all applicants What you'll need Proven experience (3–6 years) in social media management and digital marketing.Strong understanding of AI tools and platforms for social media (content creation, analytics, automation). Hands-on experience with platforms like Hootsuite, Sprout Social, Buffer, Hub Spot, Jasper, Mid Journey, Canva AI, etc.Creative mindset with the ability to generate engaging and AI-powered campaigns. Knowledge of social media algorithms, SEO, and paid campaigns. Strong analytical skills to interpret data and optimize performance. Excellent communication and storytelling skills. Location : Noida Experience : 2-4 years Apply Now Social Media Executive (Preferred from News/Media background) Noida Social Media Executive (Preferred from News/Media background) Noida Apply Now Job description We are looking for a creative and proactive Social Media Executive to manage and grow our digital presence across multiple social media platforms. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of social media trends, audience engagement, and content management. Candidates from a News or Media background will be preferred. What you'll do Manage and handle social media platforms including Instagram, Linked In, Facebook, X (Twitter), and You Tube. Create, schedule, and publish engaging content aligned with brand objectives. Monitor social media trends, viral content, and industry updates to improve engagement. Coordinate with design, content, and video teams for creative execution. Write engaging captions, post copies, and social media content. Track audience engagement, comments, messages, and community interactions. Analyze social media performance metrics and prepare basic reports. Assist in planning social media campaigns and content calendars. Ensure brand consistency across all digital platforms. What you'll need 0–2 years of experience in Social Media Management or Digital Content. Background in News, Media, Journalism, or Digital Media preferred. Strong understanding of social media platforms, trends, and audience engagement. Good written and verbal communication skills. Basic knowledge of content planning, hashtags, reels, and platform algorithms. Creative mindset with attention to detail. Ability to work in a fast-paced content environment. Location : Noida Experience : 3+ years Apply Now Front Office Admin Noida Front Office Admin Noida Apply Now About the role We are looking for a professional, well-presented, and customer-focused Front Desk Executive to be the first point of contact for our organization. The ideal candidate will have excellent communication skills, a positive attitude, and the ability to manage front office operations efficiently while ensuring a seamless experience for visitors, clients, candidates, and employees. What you'll do Welcome and assist visitors, clients, interview candidates, and employees in a courteous and professional manner. Manage the reception area, ensuring it remains organized and presentable at all times. Handle incoming calls, emails, and inquiries, and direct them to the appropriate departments. Coordinate interview schedules and assist the Talent Acquisition team with candidate management. Maintain visitor records, issue visitor passes, and ensure adherence to security protocols. Coordinate meeting room bookings and ensure meeting spaces are prepared. Manage courier services, incoming/outgoing mail, and office deliveries. Coordinate with administration, housekeeping, and security teams to ensure smooth day-to-day office operations. Assist in travel and accommodation arrangements for business visitors, when required. Support office events, employee engagement activities, and internal communications. Maintain front office records, reports, and documentation accurately. Ensure exceptional hospitality standards for guests and visitors. What you'll need Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and customer service skills. Professional appearance and positive attitude. Good organizational and multitasking abilities. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, Power Point). Ability to handle confidential information with discretion. Strong coordination and problem-solving skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced corporate environment. Location : Noida Experience : 2+ yrs Apply Now Sr. Project Manager Chandigarh Sr. Project Manager Chandigarh Apply Now About the role As a Project Manager, your primary responsibility is to lead and oversee projects from initiation to completion, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget. You will act as the bridge between various stakeholders, ensuring communication flows smoothly between the project team, clients, and other key stakeholders. Your role will require you to plan, organize, and execute projects while managing risks, resolving issues, and ensuring that all deliverables meet quality standards. What you'll do Project Planning & Execution : Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables, and develop a detailed project plan to track progress. Set milestones, timelines, and allocate resources effectively. Team Leadership : Coordinate and lead project teams, ensuring clear communication, task assignments, and high team morale. Facilitate collaboration and remove blockers for team members. Budget & Resource Management : Oversee project budget, forecast requirements, and monitor costs to stay within budgetary limits. Optimize resource allocation and ensure efficient use of available resources. Risk Management : Identify potential risks and devise strategies to mitigate or resolve them. Develop contingency plans to ensure project continuity. Client & Stakeholder Engagement : Act as the primary point of contact for clients, stakeholders, and management. Provide regular project updates, gather feedback, and manage expectations. Quality Assurance : Monitor project progress to ensure deliverables meet quality standards and customer requirements. Ensure adherence to company policies and industry best practices. Documentation & Reporting : Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including status reports, project plans, meeting minutes, and post-project evaluations. What you'll need Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business Management, Engineering, or a related field. (PMP, PRINCE2 certification is a plus) Specify years of experience, e.g., 5years] of experience in project management, ideally within the tech industry. Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., JIRA, Asana, Trello) and Microsoft Office Suite. Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies is preferred. Exceptional organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, lead teams, and manage stakeholder relationships. Proactive in identifying issues and finding solutions. Ability to handle complex problems and make effective decisions under pressure.
